latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Explainer Video skill.

- Instantly generate professional animated explainer videos from a product description.
- Supports a variety of animation styles, voiceover options, and background music.
- Covers multiple use cases: SaaS/product homepage, investor pitch, process explanation, education, and app onboarding.
- Outputs fully produced videos with animation, narration, music, and platform-ready exports (16:9, 9:16).
- Simple API: submit your product details and desired video parameters to get a polished, conversion-driven explainer video in minutes.
